hierarchy-bundles.visual_critic_note: Clean modern UI chrome with good typographic hierarchy and a warm Tableau10 palette, but the 900×900 SVG renders partially cropped in the viewport, and the full link bundle overlay creates dense visual clutter that undercuts readability of the hierarchical structure.
hierarchy-bundles.encoding_integrity_note: Structurally honest: scaleSqrt used correctly for force-layout circle sizing, data-driven domains throughout, and key functions present on node and link joins — but hierarchy link join lacks a key function and the composite link key (first-to-last node id) risks collisions on shared paths, plus synthetic data caps confidence.
hierarchy-bundles.stress_test_note: Easing-param sliders fire full 1500ms updateLayout() transitions on every input event without debouncing, and updateLayout() never calls .interrupt() on nodeSelection before creating a new svg.transition(), leaving mid-flight current_x/y state potentially inconsistent when layouts are switched rapidly.
hierarchy-bundles.cognitive_load_note: Hierarchical color grouping and circle clusters read clearly, but 300 bundled edges at 8% tension collapse into a dense central tangle that is unreadable without hover/click interaction, and the 8-layout control strip adds navigational overhead that competes with the visualization itself.
